title: AeroOreGen
description: Makes cobblestone generators generate Create resources like Andesite and Copper, compatible with Create: Aeronautics and customizable!
body:
# AeroCobbleGen for **NeoForge 1.21.1**

- Lets ores & create materials generate using cobblestone generators. More Create-focused materials can be generated by leaving a furnace block underneath the would-be-generated cobblestone.

- Works with Create: Aeronautics flying contraptions (that's basically the reason why i made this mod to begin with)

- Fully customizable: Upon first generation of a cobble block, the mod makes a file in \minecraft\config\ titled "aeronauticscobblegen.toml"; that file contains the generable blocks & their weights. You can edit it in real time and don't need to reload the game for changes to take effect!

**DISCLAIMER:** I vibe coded this & used Mcreator i'm sorry i'm a fraud
